description: B4's EDIT, the wing 48 wide (X 192..240), from ONE loft.roof 1.2.0 custom feature, Style Hip, on six picked loft.wall walls (ROOF-VALLEY; buildings.md B4 'Edit'): the wing ridge runs 24, the valley (192,120)-(216,144) ends on a hip running from there to the main ridge's end, and the main front gets 1 hip-valley cripple at X 204 (run 21.879, line 24.461); otherwise B4's inputs, tails ripped (ROOF-HIP-TAIL). model.json is EXACTLY the plugin's expansion; members.json its metadata; test_roof_valley_b4.py checks it against the independent script.
derivation: Every expectation except the counts is from the INDEPENDENT build123d script (test_roof_valley_b4.script_roof, which shares no code with the plugin: each member is its plan prism cut to the slab between its bottom and top planes, less everything below the plate inside the walls' outer faces, and a hip's or valley's tail less everything below its rip plane outside them).

Planes: slope 6/12, seat 3.5, heel 1.75, plumb depth 6.149187, HAP 4.399187; every plane rises from Z 97.125 + 4.399187 at its wall's outer face. Hips: unit 18 per 12, plumb 7.689690, drop 0.265165; the valley's top centreline on the valley line. A ripped tail's plumb depth is 6.149187 - 0.265165 = 5.884022 on the centreline.
48 bodies: 25 commons (11 on the wing, run 23.25; 1 tail-cut), 13 hip jacks, 1 cripple, 6 hips, 1 valley, 2 ridges.
volume = the independent script's sum, 25047.484092 in^3 (25323.287627 without the rips).
mass_g = volume x 450 kg/m^3 (spf_lumber); center_of_mass = centroid.

bounding_box: X and Y -12..252 (tails at the fascia), Z from the tails' bottoms at the fascia, 97.125 - 1.75 - 6 = 89.375 (the ripped hips' tail points are on that line too), to the main ridge's top 131.149187 in.
topology: 440 faces, 1032 edges, 48 shells; mesh counts recorded from the build.
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill): ABSOLUTE bounds on a ~4e8 mm^3 part of separate bodies. The kernel differs from the independent script by 1.05e-4 mm^3 in volume, 5e-7 mm^2 in area and <= 1e-10 mm in centroid (each body by <= 2e-5 mm^3, symmetric differences 0). 5e-4 is 4.7x the worst; a jack 0.001 in out of place moves the volume by > 10 mm^3.
roundtrip_tolerance_rationale: KERNEL-LEVEL, measured 2026-10-17: OCCT's STEP writer rounds the sloped members' irrational coordinates. Round-trip drift: B4 -1.30e-3 mm^3, the 48 wing -7.8e-4 mm^3; the independent build123d twin, exported with build123d's own export_step, drifts -2.37e-3 and -1.90e-3 while its axis-aligned ridges drift nothing (test_roof_valley_b4::test_the_roofs_step_drift_is_occts), so it is OCCT's STEP, not Loft's export. More sloped members than B3 (whose bound is 1e-3) drift more; 5e-3 is 3.8x the plugin's worst. Volume and area only.
